Hi Sarah / Laura,

Quick note — Sarah tried to create an Ariba supplier account this morning and got an error during the email verification step. The portal returned a domain-block notice for "@acme-retail.com" (screenshot attached).

Can procurement manually create the supplier record so we can proceed with PO issuance? I'm attaching a short onboarding checklist to capture the docs we'll need. If possible, please also open a ticket with Ariba to understand why that domain is flagged so we don't hit this again.

Required to proceed:
- Manual vendor record creation (temporary vendor ID)
- W9 or tax certificate (Sarah is pulling this now)
- Bank detail confirmation (last 4 digits)
- Any additional compliance docs (DUNS, VAT)

Attached: vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx, screenshot-domain-block.png

Thanks for the heads up, Jonas.

We see this occasionally — the Ariba tenant has a heuristic filter that blocks newly-registered domains that fail a simple reputation check. I will open a support case with Ariba support (support@ariba.com) and request a whitelist for @acme-retail.com. Reference ticket 94531 once created.

In the meantime, Marissa, can you perform a manual vendor creation so the teams can continue? If we create a temporary vendor we will need the following from Acme right away:
- Completed vendor onboarding form (attached checklist)
- Executed W9 or equivalent tax form
- Bank account last 4 digits for ACH validation
- Primary contact name and phone number

I am also attaching a link to our internal procurement runbook where we log these temporary vendor cases: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-4321

Laura
